research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Density Inc. is focused on developing systems for tracking and analyzing the movement of objects and people within environments. Their trajectory determination system employs positional sensing devices to track objects' movements, utilizing phase shift measurements of modulated Doppler pulses. Additionally, they have created an occupancy analysis system that uses depth sensing positioned above room thresholds to count people without collecting personal data, leveraging phase shift measurements of modulated infrared light. These innovations contribute to their infrastructure for measuring space utilization.

overview_description.description: Density measures how people use space in real-time without invading privacy. Using proprietary depth sensors and deep learning algorithms, the platform accurately and anonymously counts people in real time. Organizations use Density to improve efficiency and enhance occupant experience in buildings, workplaces, and real estate. Unlike a camera, Density's platform doesn't capture personally identifiable information and is purpose-built for accurately measuring how people use physical space.

about_short_description.short_description: Density builds the technical infrastructure for cities, buildings, and spaces to measure how they're used.

product.name: Waffle
product.description: A self-installable radar sensor that provides real-time anonymous people counting for rooms, phone booths, desks, and open spaces.

product.name: Atlas
product.description: A software platform for workplace occupancy analytics and space utilization insights based on sensor data.

product.name: Adaptive Cleaning
product.description: A service that uses occupancy data to optimize cleaning schedules by targeting areas based on actual usage.

product.name: Live Wayfinding
product.description: A real-time mapping and navigation tool that shows available spaces and guides users to them within a building.

product.name: API Services
product.description: APIs that provide real-time and historical occupancy data for integration with third-party applications and systems.
